test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is 'Bhuvan'

options.text: A mini satellite launched by ISRO for promoting distance education in India.
A geo-portal of ISRO with 3D imaging capabilities.
A space telescope developed by India.
The name given to the Moon Impact Probe for Chandrayaan-2.

solution:
The correct answer is__** A geo-portal of ISRO with 3D imaging capabilities.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhuvan__**, is the national Geo-portal developed and **hosted by ISRO comprising of Geo Spatial Data, Services and Tools for Analysis.**
 
• It has many **versatile features,** for Example
 
• Visualization of Satellite Imagery and Maps 
 
• Analysis
 
• Free Data Download.
 
• Download Reports to name a few.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Bhuvan, is an Indian web based utility which allows users **to explore a set of map based content **prepared by Indian Space Research Organisation. 
 
• The content which the utility serves is mostly restricted to Indian boundaries and is** offered in 4 regional languages.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/daafd027b73bc058de3f89476205072905f1f3bd798d336582eac70530a204a1.png]
